Identifying Objects in German: A1 Question Practice

Ask what an object is and how it is called in German. Practise das ist, wie heißt and singular/plural questions with translations and explained A1 answers.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Useful phrases and patterns

Was ist das? asks what a single thing is. Was sind das? can ask about several things. Wie heißt das auf Deutsch? asks for the German name. Das ist ein … identifies a singular item; Das sind … identifies several. A name question and a question about ownership have different purposes.

Common mistake to avoid

Use Wie heißt das? to ask what something is called. Was ist das? asks for identification more broadly and may receive an explanation rather than only a name.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice what the speaker wants to do, the level of politeness and the details the listener needs.

Worked example 1Was ist das für ein kleines Werkzeug?What kind of small tool is that?
Worked example 2Das ist ein Schraubenzieher für sehr kleine Schrauben.That is a screwdriver for very small screws.
Worked example 3Wie heißt dieses Teil auf Deutsch?What is this part called in German?
Worked example 4Das sind die Ersatzteile für das Regal.Those are the spare parts for the shelving unit.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the identification phrase with the question word, verb or language cue shown. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Deutsch · heißt · sind · Was

Question 1. ___ ist das für ein Gegenstand? (what)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Was

Was asks for identification of the object.

Question 2. Wie ___ dieses Gerät? (heißen)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: heißt

Heißt is the singular form in the naming question.

Question 3. Das ___ zwei kleine Klammern. (sein, plural)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: sind

Plural items take sind in this identification pattern.

Question 4. Wie sagt man das auf ___? (German)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Deutsch

Auf Deutsch asks for the German expression.

Use it in your own sentence

Ask what an unfamiliar tool is called in German.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Wie heißt dieses Werkzeug auf Deutsch?

Check your wording: The naming question differs from asking where the object is.

What to practise next

Adapt a model to a different listener or situation. Keep the request, time reference and formal or informal address consistent.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
